name: TreeMap
description: TreeMap evaluates models' ability to produce or reason about hierarchical tree-structured outputs from textual inputs (e.g., mapping text to tree representations or extracting hierarchical relations). It measures both structural correctness and content fidelity of the generated trees across a range of examples requiring nested reasoning and organization.
reputation: A newer task dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for structure-aware generation and reasoning evaluation.
